nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a vertex type $V$ and let $A$ be a finite independent set of $G$. The characteristic vector of $A$ is the Boolean function on $V$ that sends a vertex $v$ to true if $v \in A$ and to false otherwise.
nodes.title: Characteristic vector of an independent set

nodes.summary: Let $V$ and $W$ be finite types, let $R$ be a relation between $V$ and $W$, and let $a$ and $b$ be Boolean functions on $V$ and on $W$. The pairing of $a$ and $b$ along $R$ is the natural number of pairs $(v, w) \in V \times W$ such that $R(v, w)$ holds and both $a(v)$ and $b(w)$ are true.
nodes.title: Pairing of Boolean vectors along a relation

nodes.summary: Let $G$ and $H$ be simple graphs on finite vertex types $V$ and $W$, and let $R$ be a relation between $V$ and $W$. The transfer matrix of $G$ and $H$ along $R$ is indexed by pairs $(A, B)$ where $A$ is a finite independent set of $G$ and $B$ is a finite independent set of $H$. nodes.title: Transfer matrix of a generalized Zykov sum

nodes.summary: For a natural number $z$, the zero indicator of $z$ is the Boolean value that is true if $z = 0$ and false otherwise.
nodes.title: Zero indicator of a natural number

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
